welcome.title: Welcome to AI Stock Analyzer
welcome.bodyP1: This tool bundles portfolio tracking, watchlist, AI analyses, risk and macro evaluations in one place. You'll need about 5 minutes to set everything up.
welcome.bodyP2Html: Tip: Toggle the question mark in the top right to enable help mode — an info bar then explains every menu item, every table column and every chart indicator on hover.

dataSources.title: Data sources — where do the numbers come from?
dataSources.bodyIntro: AI Stock Analyzer aggregates several free sources:
dataSources.sourceYahooHtml: Yahoo Finance — prices (15-min delay), fundamentals, news, earnings, insider, dividends, financial history, ETF top holdings.
dataSources.sourceFinnhubHtml: Finnhub — real-time quotes (free tier 60 req/min) + analyst consensus, price targets, insider sentiment, earnings surprises.
dataSources.sourceStooqHtml: Stooq — backup quote provider for EU stocks.
dataSources.sourceRedditHtml: Reddit — subreddit buzz per ticker as a sentiment proxy.
dataSources.sourceFredHtml: FRED (St. Louis Fed) — macro indicators: yield curve, Fed/ECB rates, CPI, unemployment, VIX, USD/EUR, WTI oil.
dataSources.sourceSecHtml: SEC EDGAR — 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, Form-4 (insider trades) straight from the source.
dataSources.sourceWikipediaHtml: Wikipedia pageviews — daily article views as an attention proxy.
dataSources.sourceTrendsHtml: Google Trends — relative search interest + strongly rising related queries (early catalyst hints).
dataSources.sourceEcbHtml: ECB — daily FX reference rates for multi-currency portfolios.
dataSources.sourceMagazineHtml: Yahoo (PDF magazine pipeline) — AI parses uploaded market magazines.
dataSources.keysNoteHtml: External API keys (Claude/Gemini/OpenAI for AI, Finnhub/FRED for data) are stored by the admin in Admin settings — keys are stored encrypted.

aiAccess.title: Set up AI access
aiAccess.bodyP1Html: For single-stock analysis, portfolio insights, chat and macro scenarios you need your own API key with one of the supported providers: Claude (Anthropic), Gemini (Google), Groq or OpenAI. You store the key in Settings under "AI" — requests go directly between your browser and the provider.
aiAccess.bodyP2Html: Instructions per provider — where to get the key, what it costs, which limits apply — under Help & FAQ → Set up API keys.

dashboard.title: Dashboard — your cockpit
dashboard.bodyP1Html: On the dashboard you see portfolio value, P/L, day change, 180-day equity chart, health score and top market movers.
dashboard.bodyP2Html: Use the "Customize" button to toggle widgets on/off and reorder them — saved in your browser.

portfolio.title: Create your portfolio
portfolio.bodyP1: Enter positions manually or import a CSV export from your broker (Trade Republic, comdirect, ING, IBKR …).
portfolio.bodyP2: From your positions we later compute performance metrics, tax report, risk analyses and the weekly briefing digest.

watchlist.title: Watchlist & alerts
watchlist.bodyP1Html: In the watchlist you collect tracked stocks with a trend sparkline, 52-week position and conviction score.
watchlist.bodyP2Html: Alerts are price or indicator triggers (RSI < 30, MACD cross, 52-week high, …) — when triggered you get an email and optionally a web push notification.

aiAnalysis.title: AI analysis per stock
aiAnalysis.bodyP1Html: On every stock's detail page you can trigger an AI analysis. The AI receives fundamentals, news, Reddit buzz, Wikipedia attention, Google Trends, Finnhub analytics (consensus, price targets, insider) and SEC filings — and returns a recommendation + reasoning + risks/opportunities.
aiAnalysis.bodyP2Html: Multi-model consensus lets several providers analyze in parallel and shows agreement/disagreement.

risk.title: Risk analyses
risk.bodyP1Html: Under Portfolio → Risk you get value-at-risk, Monte Carlo simulation, historical stress tests (COVID, 2008, rate shock) and a factor exposure breakdown (value/growth/quality/momentum).
risk.bodyP2Html: The portfolio health score on the dashboard summarizes the whole portfolio into a grade A–F.

macro.title: Macro & macro scenarios
macro.bodyP1Html: Macro & sentiment shows market breadth, fear & greed, Reddit sentiment.
macro.bodyP2Html: Macro scenarios simulate concrete shocks ("ECB +100bp", "Brent $120", "AI bubble pops") against your portfolio. The AI rates each position individually and gives an overall impact.

marketRadar.title: Market radar
marketRadar.bodyIntroHtml: What is moving right now? The market radar shows:
marketRadar.li1: Attention spikes (Wikipedia + Google) on your tickers
marketRadar.li2: Top 20 news from your watchlist + portfolio
marketRadar.li3: AI idea generator for stocks you don't hold

screener.title: Screener, breakouts & discoveries
screener.bodyP1Html: Screener: multi-criteria filter (P/E, yield, sector, …) across the stock universe.
screener.bodyP2Html: Breakout: stocks breaking out of 52-week highs/lows or violating Bollinger Bands right now.
screener.bodyP3Html: Discoveries: AI recommendations of stocks similar to your portfolio + gap analysis.

trackRecord.title: AI track record
trackRecord.bodyHtml: How good were the AI recommendations really? The AI track record compares every saved recommendation against the subsequent price action — hit rate, avg. return and buckets per model.

chat.title: Chat & briefing
chat.bodyP1Html: Chat ("Ask the Portfolio") — natural-language chat with your portfolio context, streaming answers.
chat.bodyP2Html: Weekly briefing — daily/weekly AI report: what changed, new risks, new opportunities.

personalization.title: Personalization
personalization.li3Html: AI — own API keys, model selection, limits
personalization.li4Html: Notifications — email address, alerts, digest, web push

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.bodyP1Html: Cmd/Ctrl + K opens the command palette: open a page, run an action or analyze a ticker — the fastest way through the app.
shortcuts.bodyP2: Top right of the nav: bell for notifications, question mark for help mode, avatar for logout/settings.

help.title: Help & glossary
help.bodyP1Html: All features are documented under Help & FAQ, financial terms are explained in the glossary, ready-to-use investment strategies live under Strategies.
help.bodyP2Html: Don't forget the help mode in the top right — it explains every menu item, every table column and every chart indicator on hover.
help.disclaimer: ⚠️ AI Stock Analyzer is not financial advice and provides informational content only.
